title: The Causal Impact of Distance on Bank Lending
authors: Christoph Herpfer; Aksel Mjøs; Cornelius Schmidt
eligible_reason: Design qualifies: binary absorbing treatment (travel-time reduction >= 2 min and 10% to the relationship bank, treat_2min; or to competing banks, maxtreatmean_norel_2) switching on in different years as infrastructure projects open, never-treated pairs present, pair FE plus branch x year and municipality x year FE, no controls in Table 4 cols 1-2 and Table 7 cols 1-2. Not eligible because the package ships only a simulated pseudo dataset (treatment Bernoulli(0.5), outcomes uniform(0,1)); the real data are confidential Norwegian tax-authority and registry records. Not a near-miss: clean columns exist; the barrier is data.
design_notes: Norwegian firm-bank panel. Two samples: (i) readyforopen.dta, firm x potential bank-branch pairs, outcome accountyesno (relationship initiation, Table 4); (ii) readyforaccountregression.dta, existing relationships, outcome interestrate (Table 7). Treatment built in H_Prepare_Data.do lines 155-181: relreduction2 = 1 if travel time falls >= 10% and >= 2 min year over year; treat_2min = running sum >= 1 by firm-bank pair (absorbing); first-relationship years set to missing. Competing-bank treatment (lines 331-350): firm-level indicator for a >= 2 min drop in mean distance to the 5 closest non-relationship banks, made absorbing via running max. Column 3 of each table includes both treatments (extra treatment); column 4 adds time-varying controls; Tables 6, 8-11 add intensity buckets or treatment x moderator interactions. Figure 3 event study (I_firm_branch_tables_COMBINED.do line 11): leads/lags -2..+2 for both treatments jointly plus controls (excluded). Table A10: project-level post_project x willbetreatedorwastreated design with controls (appendix). Table A11 (I_firm_branch_tables_COMBINED.do from line 612): same clean single-treatment columns re-estimated, plus a variant with commuting-region x year FE (commuteyeargroup); appendix only.
estimators_reported: TWFE static (pair FE + branch x year + municipality x year)
TWFE event study (Figure 3, leads/lags without endpoint binning)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Real cohort structure unknown (simulated data); pseudo files span 2001-2011 (accounts) and 2001-2020 (relationship-opening file); real openings of infrastructure projects are spread over the period per the README.
